title: Exact total variation for finite sampling from a population with one repeated pair: a Lean formalization
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in construction, implementation, verification and separate AI source review. Not human peer review.

canonical_source.note: The archive supplies the canonical public immutable source snapshot.

claim: For the canonical population q identifying distinct indices a,b, the actual ordered sampling laws without and with replacement have signed variation mass 2*(1-p-t*min(p,1-p)), p=(n)_m/n^m, t=(m)_2/(n)_2. Probability TV is half this mass.
assumptions: a!=b, q sends b to a and fixes other indices
Measurable singletons on the population alphabet
